meta.title: Dispatch Copilot: launch, package and price
meta.subtitle: Discussion document for the CEO and executive team, January 2027 planning
meta.purpose: Decide whether to launch Dispatch Copilot in Q2 2027, and how to package and price it

inputs.label: Checkpoint choices
inputs.content: The user was not available for questions and asked for the recommended option at every checkpoint: deep deck (deck_deep), navy theme, client diagnostic, 30–40 slides, problem statement and issue tree as drafted, storyline as built.

storyline.governing_thought: Launch Copilot in Q2 2027 in a per-seat Pro plan with a usage cap, not as a $149 add-on, and plan on $2.9M of ARR, not $8M

exec_summary.text: Copilot helps the volunteers who chose it, but its value for the base is unproven

sub_points.text: Only 6% of accounts that left in 2026 left for AI features

exec_summary.text: Customers will pay, but plan on about $2.5–2.9M of first-year ARR, not the $8M forecast

sub_points.text: 14% bought at $149 when asked to pay; 46% said they would
The whole win-rate drop to Routewise is worth about $0.6M a year

exec_summary.text: Only a per-seat Pro plan with a usage cap holds margin above 75% and closes the NRR gap

sub_points.text: A top-10% account would use 88% of a flat $149 price in inference
Pro hits 105% NRR if 26% of accounts move; 33% did in 2023

exec_summary.text: The launch is worth a two-quarter mobile delay, as long as the delay stops there

sub_points.text: The delay risks at most $1.1M of ARR, 38% of what Pro adds

exec_summary.text: Launch Pro in Q2 2027, test it beyond volunteers, and return the team to mobile right after

sub_points.text: Watch take-up against 26%, cost per seat and the mobile restart

next_steps.action: Approve the Pro plan launch for Q2 2027 at $12 more per seat, with a request allowance
Fix the Copilot team's return to the mobile rewrite for Q3 2027 in the engineering plan
Set the allowance and overage price, and test them against beta usage
Test the Pro offer and a time study on accounts that did not volunteer
Code loss reasons separately for AI and price in Routewise deals

problem.statement: Should Brightwork launch Dispatch Copilot in Q2 2027, and in what package and at what price, to lift net revenue retention from 101% to 105% by 2028 while keeping gross margin at or above 75%?
problem.decision_maker: CEO and executive team, approving the launch, package and engineering plan
success_criteria: Company gross margin stays at or above 75%
The two-quarter delay to the mobile app rewrite is worth what Copilot adds
problem.accuracy: Order of magnitude (±25%) on ARR and margin; beta evidence treated as an upper bound
out_of_scope: Own AI model or a new provider

one_day_answer.situation: Copilot finished a 12-week free beta with volunteers who liked it, and the CPO proposes a $149 add-on worth about $8M of new ARR
one_day_answer.complication: Only 14% paid when asked, heavy users would eat a flat price, Routewise sells AI inside its plan, and launching delays the mobile app customers leave over
one_day_answer.resolution: Launch in Q2 2027 inside a Pro plan priced per seat with a request allowance, plan on about $2.9M of ARR, and send the team back to mobile right after launch
